hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched from off to on at 2026-11-10T06:42:05Z. This enabled the spend summary path, which raises ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 and fails about 30% of account page requests. No code or config changed, and no deployment exists. Argus switched the flag off at 2026-11-10T06:47:17Z, but later minutes still show the flag evaluating on and the errors returning. Some evaluations kept serving the on value after the off toggle, so the flag state looks inconsistent.
